definitions.explanation: A small, typically ceramic cup used for drinking sake. Usually holds about 30-50 ml. A staple item at izakaya and traditional Japanese restaurants.

examples.japanese: お{猪口|ちょこ}で{日本酒|にほんしゅ}を{飲|の}む。
examples.english: To drink sake from an ochoko cup.

examples.japanese: このお{猪口|ちょこ}は{有田焼|ありたやき}です。
examples.english: This sake cup is Arita ware.

examples.japanese: {祖父|そふ}は{毎晩|まいばん}お{猪口|ちょこ}に{二|に}{杯|はい}だけ{日本酒|にほんしゅ}を{飲|の}むのが{習慣|しゅうかん}だった。
examples.english: My grandfather's habit was to drink just two small cups of sake every evening.

notes: The お is an honorific prefix and is almost always included. Without it, {猪口|ちょこ} alone is rarely used. Distinct from {盃|さかずき} (a flat, saucer-shaped sake cup used in ceremonies) and {枡|ます} (a square wooden box sometimes used for sake). お{猪口|ちょこ} comes in many styles and is a popular souvenir item.
